body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Panasonic presented its ultra-compact and stylish camcorder 'SDR-S15' during CES 2009, which records to SD cards.
Appealing to club hoppers and fashion-conscious consumers, the SDR-S15 features Intelligent Auto(iA) mode and comes in Black, Silver and, Chocolate.
The Panasonic SDR-S15 features a 0.6-second Quick-Start function and are equipped with built-in VideoCam Suite software for easy YouTube uploading.
The Panasonic SDR-S15 will ship in April, and should sell for approximately $300 respectively.
